name: Magnitude/Phase Pairs per Echo
description: Validates that each unique echo time has at least one magnitude and one phase image (e.g. required for QSM and other phase-based processing).

testCases.name: Valid pairs
testCases.description: Should pass with M and P at each echo

testCases.name: Missing phase
testCases.description: Should fail when phase is missing at one echo

testCases.name: Missing magnitude
testCases.description: Should fail when magnitude is missing
